scope: The two Umeda Sky Building towers in Osaka as seen in April 2011, including their stepped glazed shafts, open plaza, Floating Garden Observatory and paired inclined escalators.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Sekisui House records two forty-storey towers, approximately 173 metres of height and 40-metre enclosed escalators.
Osaka’s official guide places the escalator between the 35th and 39th floors and the roof deck above the 40th floor.
Japan’s national tourism organization identifies the 1993 twin towers and Hiroshi Hara’s linked observatory.
